translations.web: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile of wood for the bones under the cauldron. Make it boil well. Yes, let its bones be boiled within it.”
translations.bsb: Take the choicest of the flock and pile the fuel beneath it. Bring it to a boil and cook the bones in it.’
translations.kjv: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.
translations.asv: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile of wood for the bones under the caldron; make it boil well; yea, let the bones thereof be boiled in the midst of it.
